subject: POC kickoff — hands-on session scheduling, prompt review, traffic/load tests, and fallback rules
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@acme.com>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff — hands-on session scheduling, prompt review, traffic/load tests, and fallback rules

Hi Sam / Jill,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the hands-on POC with Redwood. We'd like to lock in a kickoff that combines: (1) a short product demo and prompt review, (2) routing policy working session (model selection, fallback rules, regional tiering), and (3) a short load test to validate throughput assumptions.

Proposed high-level agenda (90 minutes):
- 0–20m: Intro + demo (Redwood)
- 20–45m: Prompt review & prompt-set walkthrough (joint)
- 45–75m: Routing policy workshop — model variants, fallback matrix, regional routing
- 75–90m: Quick traffic/load smoke test + next steps

Proposed dates/times (Pacific):
- Tue 2026-10-13, 9:00–10:30am PT
- Wed 2026-10-14, 11:00am–12:30pm PT
- Fri 2026-10-16, 8:00–9:30am PT

Attachments: POC-Agenda-v2.pdf (detailed agenda), example-load-script.csv (sample traffic profile), fallback-matrix.xlsx (starter template)

Can you confirm which slot works best and who will join from your side for the prompt review and traffic test? Also let us know if you prefer a shorter technical-only session (we can compress demo to 10m).

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
From: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@acme.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Jill Moreno <j.moreno@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on session scheduling, prompt review, traffic/load tests, and fallback rules

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the agenda. We (Acme) are generally available but the times you listed are a little early for our London office. Can we aim for a slot that works for both LA and London? Our preferred windows (BST): 2026-10-13 5pm–7pm BST or 2026-10-14 6pm–8pm BST.

Also: we want a clear discussion on fallback rules per region (especially EU vs US), and someone to confirm the implications of model quantization on latency during the load test. Can your team include someone who can speak to quantized model performance?

Sam Tucker
Head of AI Platforms, Acme Corp
sam.tucker@acme.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: POC kickoff — scheduling notes from Acme (timezones + quantization ask)

Team — forwarding Sam's reply. Quick coordination items:
- We need someone who can speak to quantized performance (Dev — can you lead that segment?).
- Chloe: please own the prompt review track and prepare the 10 sample prompts from Acme doc link.
- Evelyn: can you validate infra requirements for the load smoke test (GPU types, ramp plan) and confirm whether we can run the example-load-script.csv against a small test pool?

Proposed compromise times (PT / BST):
- Tue 2026-10-13, 3:00–4:30pm PT (11:00pm–12:30am BST) — late for London, not ideal
- Wed 2026-10-14, 7:00–8:30am PT (3:00pm–4:30pm BST) — matches Sam's window better

If Wed 2026-10-14 7:00–8:30am PT works for everyone, I'll tentatively hold and send an invite with the agenda and links. Please reply with availability and whether you need any specific test creds or sandbox endpoints.

Thanks — Soojin
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC kickoff — scheduling notes from Acme (timezones + quantization ask)

Soojin / team — I can cover quantized model performance and run the smoke load. Notes:
- I'll provision a small GPU cluster (1xA10 / 2xT4 fallback) in our sandbox region for Wed 2026-10-14 morning PT.
- Need Acme to provide an API key (test) or allow our temporary demo key to be used for the traffic script; otherwise we'll run a synthetic traffic profile.
- The load script in example-load-script.csv looks fine for a 10–15 minute smoke test; I'll shorten it to a ramp-up of 1 → 30 RPS and attach updated CSV to the invite.

I am available Wed 7:00–8:30am PT. Chloe — if you can share the prompts by EOD Tue I will wire them into the test harness.

—Dev
Senior Inference Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Confirmed: POC hands-on session — Wed 2026-10-14 7:00–8:30am PT / 3:00–4:30pm BST — calendar invite + prep

Hi Sam / Jill — thanks for the quick turnaround. Wed 2026-10-14 7:00–8:30am PT (3:00–4:30pm BST) is confirmed. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

Agenda (final):
- 7:00–7:10am PT: Quick intro + goals
- 7:10–7:30am PT: Demo + prompt review (Chloe lead)
- 7:30–8:05am PT: Routing policy workshop — model variants, regional fallback matrix (Dev + Soojin)
- 8:05–8:25am PT: Smoke load test (Dev runs ramp)
- 8:25–8:30am PT: Next steps + owners

Attachments: POC-Agenda-v2.pdf, fallback-matrix.xlsx (starter, please fill comments), example-load-script.csv (Dev will attach updated ramped CSV to the invite)

Action items before the session:
- Acme: share a single test API key or confirm we can use the Redwood demo key (Sam)
- Chloe: post prompt examples to the shared doc by EOD Tue: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1poctemplate/edit
- Dev: confirm sandbox endpoints and attach updated load CSV to the invite
